Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4513220 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, and join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units. Do not deduplicate.
